promise: Solo travel for Indian women — and the plan that gets your family to yes.
positioning: A solo travel platform for Indian women: the confidence to go, and a complete plan your family can read before you do.
customDomainNote: Set this to a bare domain (e.g. "pehchan.travel") once its DNS points at GitHub Pages. It then overrides origin/basePath and the build emits a CNAME file. Do NOT set it before DNS resolves — GitHub will start serving the custom domain and the site becomes unreachable until DNS is correct.

affiliate.disclosureShort: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you book through them we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
affiliate.note: No partner contracts are active yet. Every booking module below is a live, tracked slot waiting for a partner link — nothing on this site fabricates prices, availability or offers.

sampleContentNotice: Stays and experiences in this catalogue are illustrative sample listings created to demonstrate the page structure and booking flow. They are clearly labelled and will be replaced by verified, first-hand reviewed properties as partnerships are confirmed.
basePathNote: GitHub serves a user site only when the repo is named <account>.github.io. This repo is a project site, so it lives under a subpath. Ignored when customDomain is set.

tripReports.submissionEndpointNote: Set to a form-handling URL (Formspree, Basin, or your own API) that accepts a POST of JSON. Until it is set, the share form saves a draft in the browser and offers the text for the traveller to send by email, rather than silently losing what she wrote.
tripReports.reviewSlaNote: Published within this many hours of submission. This is a promise a person keeps, not something the software enforces — see docs/12.

googleForm.actionUrlNote: The Google Form's POST target: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/<FORM_ID>/formResponse. Free, never pauses, and the linked Sheet is both the database and the review queue. Setup in docs/14.
googleForm.fieldsNote: Maps our field names to the Google Form's entry IDs, e.g. {"destination": "entry.123456789"}. Get them from the form's pre-filled link. Unmapped fields are appended to the story field so nothing she writes is lost.

tripReports.fallbackFieldNote: Entry ID of one long-answer Google Form question that collects any fields with no mapping of their own. Strongly recommended — without it, unmapped answers are dropped.
